# monotaur_webhook_subscription (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur webhook subscription by its ID. The signing key is write-only and not exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_webhook_subscription" "incidents" {
  id = "12"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the webhook subscription to look up.

### Read-Only

- `auto_disabled_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when delivery disabled the subscription after too many failures, or null.
- `consecutive_failure_count` (Number) Deliveries in a row that ended `Failed` (system-managed, read-only).
- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the subscription was created.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether events are delivered to the subscription.
- `event_types` (Set of String) The CloudEvent types delivered to the subscription.
- `legacy_signature_enabled` (Boolean) Whether deliveries also carry the deprecated body-only `X-Monotaur-Signature-256` header.
- `payload_mode` (String) How much of the resource a delivery carries: `Full` or `ChangesOnly`.
- `previous_signing_key_expiry_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp until which deliveries are also signed with the previous key, or null.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the subscription was last updated.
- `url` (String) The `https` URL deliveries are POSTed to.
